brief:
Al Jazeera English reported that a doctor in Gaza has been killed as Israel's military campaign continues to devastate Palestinian healthcare infrastructure. The outlet cited the incident as part of a broader pattern of attacks on medical facilities and personnel across Gaza and the West Bank.

Mass detentions and military operations have severely disrupted healthcare delivery in both territories, according to the report. Medical services face mounting casualties among staff, destruction of facilities, and systemic collapse of the system's capacity to treat civilians.
dek: Israel's military campaign and mass detentions collapse Palestinian healthcare in Gaza and the West Bank.
title: Israel's military operations kill Gaza doctor amid healthcare collapse
